entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: A racing team from Duskmourn of possessed racers and tormentors in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Speed Demon
entities.description: The demonic minder who tormented the team captain Winter.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A Duskmourn survivor and captain of the Speed Demons, granted leave to win the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young beast able to navigate the Omenpaths, held captive by Winter.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Loot to the finish line.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage who aided Mohar Varma and captured Winter.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Deposed Avishkari politician who planned a coup.

entities.name: Spitfire
entities.description: Aether Rangers racer in first place near the finish.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: Racing team that won the Grand Prix.

events.summary: Winter and the Speed Demon held Loot captive to use his abilities in the race.
events.quote: Winter and the Speed Demon held Loot captive and planned to take advantage of his abilities in the race.

events.summary: Safety measures activated by Mohar Varma totaled Spitfire's and Winter's cars.
events.quote: Spitfire and Winter's cars were both totaled by autonomous safety measures

events.summary: Jace rendered Winter unconscious and searched his mind for Loot's whereabouts.
events.quote: Jace approached and rendered him unconscious with his mental magic

events.summary: Chandra arrived with Loot, forcing a confrontation with Jace.
events.quote: the arrival of Chandra at the finish line with Loot in tow forced Jace into a confrontation

events.summary: The Champions of Amonkhet narrowly beat Winter to first place, and Winter was dragged into Duskmourn.
events.quote: a door to Duskmourn opened at his location and he was dragged inside

relations.note: granted temporary leave to win the Aetherspark
relations.quote: Winter is a survivor of Duskmourn who has been granted temporary leave by Valgavoth
who had consolidated power with the help of the planeswalker Jace Beleren
forced Jace into a confrontation with his fellow planeswalker
